question: Lohri is a popular folk festival of which of these states?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Punjab**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lohri** is a popular **folk festival** celebrated primarily in the state of **Punjab**.
 
• This festival is observed on the **13th of January** every year.
 
• Lohri marks the **end of winter** and is traditionally associated with the harvest of the **rabi crops**.
 
• The festival involves **bonfires**, around which people gather to sing and dance, especially the **Bhangra** and **Gidda**.
 
• It is also a time for people to enjoy traditional sweets and foods like **rewari, gajak, and tilgul**.
 
• Lohri has significant cultural importance among **Sikhs and Hindus** in Punjab and is celebrated with much enthusiasm.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Goa**__

 __
 
• Goa is famous for its **beaches** and **Portuguese heritage**.
 
• Goa is known for its vibrant **carnival** and **New Year celebrations**.
 
 
 
• **Gujarat**__
 __
 
• Gujarat is famous for the festival of **Navratri** and its **Garba dance**.
 
• The state is also known for the **Rann of Kutch** and the **Gir National Park**, home to Asiatic lions.
 
 
 
• **Himachal Pradesh**__
 
 
• Himachal Pradesh is famous for its **hill stations** and scenic landscapes.
 
• The state is known for its festivals like **Dussehra** in Kullu and **Minjar** in Chamba.
